title: Overview
text:
VTDownloader UI Refresh 
 A new interface for VTDownloader's download screen. 
  
 Install it next to  VTDownloader , which still does the work. Remove this mod and its own screen comes back. 
 
 VTDownloader is by  IotaBread . Packs are by  Vanilla Tweaks . Not affiliated with or endorsed by Mojang, Microsoft, IotaBread or Vanilla Tweaks. 
 
  GitHub Releases ↗    Coming soon to Modrinth + CurseForge

title: Install
text:
Install 
 For Minecraft 26.2. Java 25. Client-side only. 
 
  Fabric 
 
 
 Install  Fabric Loader  0.19.3 or newer. 
 Install  Fabric API . 
 Install  VTDownloader  2.6.0 or newer. 
 Put the jar from  GitHub Releases  in  mods .    Coming soon to Modrinth + CurseForge

title: Use
text:
Use 
  
 Open  Options , then  Resource Packs , and click  Download VT Resource Pack . 
 Panels 
  
 Drag a panel's edge to resize it. Under a 400-pixel window width, Selected packs drops out. 
 Conflicts 
  
 Packs that conflict turn the same color once you've picked both. 
 Installed 
  Installed  shows the packs in every Vanilla Tweaks zip in your resource packs folder. With more than one zip, chips at the top pick one. 
 Download 
 Type a name and press  Download . The pack is saved in your resource packs folder. 
 Share 
  Share  gives you a vanillatweaks.net link to the current selection. 
 Edit a pack 
 Click the pencil on a Vanilla Tweaks pack on the Resource Packs screen to load its selection. 
 Keys 
     Key  Does    
  Click a category  Shows its packs and subcategories.  
  Click Installed, at the bottom of the sidebar  Shows the packs in your Vanilla Tweaks zips.  
   Cmd 1  to  Cmd 9   Opens the first to ninth category.  
   Ctrl Tab   Ctrl Shift Tab   Opens the next or previous sidebar row.  
  Click a pack  Selects or deselects it.  
  Shift-click a pack  Selects or deselects a range.  
   Cmd A   Selects every pack in the list. Again to deselect.  
   Cmd Shift A   Deselects every pack in every category.  
  Click the arrow on a pack  Opens its page.  
   ←   →   ↑   ↓   Moves the outline over the packs. Right opens a pack's page.  
   Space   Enter   Selects or deselects the outlined pack. Hold Shift for a range.  
   Cmd F   Searches every category, for every word in a pack's name or description.  
   Esc   Closes a pack's page, or the search.  
  Back and Forward,  Cmd [   Cmd ] , or the mouse's side buttons  Moves through the categories you've visited.  
  List and grid buttons  Switches how packs are shown.  
  Drag a panel's edge  Resizes it.  
  Drag a panel's edge to the window's edge  Hides the panel.  
  Click the arrow on the window's edge  Brings a hidden panel back.  
   
 Cmd on a Mac, Ctrl elsewhere. 
 Commands 
 They work on any server. Add  --reload  to any but  list  to apply it straight away: the zip turns on and the game reloads. Tab completes pack ids, and a chat line fits about 12 of them. 
  
   Command  Does   
 
   /vtd list   Lists your Vanilla Tweaks zips, and which are on.  
   /vtd list <zip>   Lists the packs in a zip.  
   /vtd create <zip> <packs>   Makes a zip from the packs.  
   /vtd edit <zip> add <packs>   Adds packs to a zip.  
   /vtd edit <zip> remove <packs>   Removes packs from a zip.  
   /vtd load <zip>   Turns a zip on.  
   /vtd unload <zip>   Turns a zip off.

title: Configure
text:
Configure 
 There's no settings screen. 
 Settings 
 Saved in  config/vtd_ui_refresh/config.json . Delete it to reset. 
     Setting  Default  Notes    
   packLayout    LIST    LIST  or  GRID .  
   sidebarWidth   A quarter of the window, 112 to 160  GUI pixels.  
   sidebarHidden    false    true  or  false .  
   selectedPacksWidth   A fifth of the window, 104 to 150  GUI pixels.  
   selectedPacksHidden    false    true  or  false .  
   
 Icons and previews are cached in  config/vtd_ui_refresh/cache . It's safe to delete.

title: Troubleshooting
text:
Troubleshooting 
     Problem  Fix    
   requires vt_downloader   Install VTDownloader for your Minecraft version.  
  The screen looks like VTDownloader's own  Check that this mod's jar is in  mods  and matches your Minecraft version.  
   error while trying to get the packs   Check your connection and that vanillatweaks.net is up, then press the reload button.  
  Download stays grayed out  Select at least one pack, and check the name. The field says what's wrong with it.  
   A file with that name already exists   Choose another name, or remove the old pack from your resource packs folder.  
   That file name is a reserved Windows name   Choose another name. Names like  CON  don't work on Windows. 
 
  The  Selected packs  panel is gone, with no arrow  The window is under 400 GUI pixels wide. Enlarge it or lower the GUI scale.  
   Installed  is empty  It only reads zips and folders made by Vanilla Tweaks, which hold a  Selected Packs.txt . Packs downloaded elsewhere don't count.  
  An icon looks out of date  Delete  config/vtd_ui_refresh/cache/icons  and open the screen again.  
  A pack's page says  No preview   The preview didn't download, or it's a WebP, which the game can't read. Delete  config/vtd_ui_refresh/cache/previews  to try again.  
  A pack doesn't apply  Turn it on under  Resource Packs . Downloading doesn't enable it.  
  Broken config  Delete  config/vtd_ui_refresh/config.json  and relaunch.  
   
  Report issues  with  logs/latest.log  and your Minecraft, mods and loader versions, or  upstream  if VTDownloader does the same without this mod. 
 Limits 
 
 VTDownloader sets the Vanilla Tweaks version when it's built. There's no picker in the game. 
 This mod uses VTDownloader's internals, so a new VTDownloader release can need a new build of this mod. 
 Resource packs only. Data packs and crafting tweaks aren't available. 
 The pack list needs a connection to vanillatweaks.net, and so do icons that aren't cached yet.

title: Changelog
text:
Changelog 
 [Unreleased] 
 Changed 
 
 Everything the mod saves is now in  config/vtd_ui_refresh/ :  config.json  and  cache/ . The layout is JSON instead of properties. Files from older versions move there on launch. 
 
 Added 
 
  Commands:   /vtd  lists, makes and edits Vanilla Tweaks zips, and turns them on or off.  --reload  applies a change straight away. 
 
 [1.0.0] - 2026-11-05 
 A companion mod, split out of a fork of VTDownloader. It requires VTDownloader 2.6.0 or newer. 
 Added 
 
 Installed: a row at the bottom of the sidebar lists the packs in the Vanilla Tweaks zips in your resource pack folder. Chips at the top show one zip at a time. 
 Keyboard: the arrow keys move over the packs, and Space or Enter selects one. Cmd/Ctrl+1 to 9 open a category. Ctrl+Tab and Ctrl+Shift+Tab move through the sidebar. 
 Pack pages: the arrow on a pack opens its preview, animated GIFs included, its whole description in the colors Vanilla Tweaks gives it, and the packs it can't be used with. Previews are kept in  cache/vtd_ui_refresh/previews . 
 Icon cache: pack icons are kept in  cache/vtd_ui_refresh/icons , so they download once per Vanilla Tweaks version. 
 Range selection: shift-click selects or deselects every pack from the last one clicked, in the list or the grid. 
 Select all: Cmd/Ctrl+A selects every pack in the list, or deselects them if they're all selected. Cmd/Ctrl+Shift+A deselects everything. Neither acts while a text field has focus. 
 Search: Cmd/Ctrl+F searches names and descriptions across all categories. 
 Side panels: drag either edge to resize, or to the window's edge to hide. An arrow brings a panel back. Widths and hidden state are remembered. 
 Back and forward: buttons, Cmd/Ctrl+[ and ], and the mouse's side buttons. Each returns to where the list was scrolled. 
 Grid view: a choice of list or tiles, remembered between sessions. 
 
 Changed 
 
 New look: Vanilla Tweaks orange on black, a vertical category sidebar, and a cleaner reload icon. 
 Subcategories: rows after their category's packs, with a few of their icons, or boxes in the grid. 
 Descriptions: a list row shows two lines, and a pack's page the rest. Packs have no tooltips. Category warnings show all of their text. 
 Popups: the share and error popups draw above the list, with room around the text. 
 Category buttons: only the button reacts to the mouse, not the space around it. 
 
 Fixed 
 
 Deselecting the last pack of a subcategory left its category heading in Selected packs, drawn over the next one. 
 A crash on warning colors written in hex, like  #242423 , in the categories Block Outlines and Legacy Console Edition. The new screen reads them. VTDownloader's own screen doesn't.
